rows.rationale: An unsigned relay sheet merely supplies a figure; nothing in the passage says that an earlier recorded value was superseded, so it cannot support the claim.
The unsigned live-feed copy states a value but records no supersession or withdrawal, and unsigned copies carry no independent authority.
The note describes a different parallel review, so it neither records a supersession for this delivery nor supplies a value for it.
An unsigned tabbed feed states a figure only; no earlier value is displaced or withdrawn in the passage.
The parallel incident note belongs to another review and records plain figures, not a supersession.
Same as the other parallel notes: it reports figures for a parallel review and says nothing about an earlier value being replaced.
The unsigned copy is a plain transcription of a value with no supersession, retraction or override in the text.
This is a parallel incident note for a different review; its figures, including 5 completed runs, displace nothing in this delivery's record.
